title: Large language models exhibit unreliable updating of clinical judgment as patient evidence evolves
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for clinical reasoning, but whether they appropriately revise judgments as patient evidence evolves remains unclear. We evaluated longitudinal belief updating using matched intensive-care trajectories from electronic health records. Across diverse LLMs, conditioning on a preceding judgment more often increased than reduced prediction error when estimates changed, replicated for a second endpoint. Controlled interventions revealed two failure modes. First, with preceding assessment fixed, models responded more strongly to worsening than matched improving respiratory evidence; this asymmetry persisted after headroom normalization at moderate and strong evidence levels. Second, with current evidence fixed, increasing prior risk from 10% to 90% shifted estimates by 26.2 percentage points, demonstrating causal influence of prior model beliefs. Prompting did not restore reliable updating. Evidence-Validated Longitudinal Update (EVLU) identified fewer, more reliable revisions, revealing a reliability-coverage trade-off. These findings establish longitudinal belief updating as a distinct dimension of LLM reliability.
tldr: This paper examines whether large language models appropriately update clinical judgments as patient evidence evolves, using ICU trajectories and controlled interventions. It finds that LLMs often revise estimates unreliably—overreacting to worsening evidence and being biased by prior risk—and introduces EVLU, a metric that identifies fewer but more reliable updates.
tldr_zh: 该论文评估了大语言模型在患者证据动态变化时是否能合理更新临床判断，发现模型常出现不可靠的修正：对恶化证据反应过强，并受先验风险影响，同时提出了EVLU指标以识别更少但更可靠的更新。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在临床推理中的应用日益受到探索，但它们在患者证据演变时能否恰当修正判断仍不明确。我们利用电子健康记录中匹配的重症监护轨迹评估了纵向信念更新。在多种LLM中，当估计值发生变化时，以前一个判断为条件相比减少预测误差更常增加预测误差，这一发现在第二个终点上得到重复。受控干预揭示了两种失效模式。第一，在前述评估固定的情况下，模型对恶化的呼吸证据的反应强于对匹配的改善呼吸证据的反应；这种不对称性在中等和强证据水平下经净空归一化后依然存在。第二，在当前证据固定的情况下，将先前风险从10%提高到90%会使估计偏移26.2个百分点，表明先前模型信念具有因果影响。提示 prompting 并不能恢复可靠的更新。证据验证的纵向更新（EVLU）识别出更少但更可靠的修正，揭示了可靠性—覆盖范围的权衡。这些发现确立了纵向信念更新作为LLM可靠性的一个独立维度。

title: SCOPE-4D: Endoscopic 4D Geometry Foundation Models
summary: Geometric understanding supports endoscopic navigation and robotic assistance, but learning reliable endoscopic geometry faces two challenges: scarce geometric annotations and ambiguity between camera motion and tissue deformation. We present SCOPE-4D, an endoscopic 4D geometry foundation model that jointly predicts camera parameters, dense geometry, and 3D tissue trajectories from monocular RGB video in a single forward pass. Our curation and annotation pipeline constructs SCOPE-5K, a collection of approximately 5,000 clips spanning real and synthetic gastrointestinal endoscopy and laparoscopy. The collection provides rich geometric supervision and includes newly collected phantom and real-colonoscopy evaluation sets. Geometric supervised fine-tuning on SCOPE-5K learns endoscopic priors that improve camera and depth estimation. Common--Residual Motion (CRM) further constrains local deformation relative to common tissue movement. Together with geometric supervision, CRM and trajectory supervision further improve camera and depth estimation over geometric fine-tuning alone while enabling dense 3D tissue tracking. Evaluations on public and newly collected benchmarks demonstrate strong in-domain and out-of-domain geometry, superior 3D tracking, and more stable long-sequence colon reconstruction. A blinded user study further supports the perceived reconstruction quality on real clinical video. Together, these results demonstrate the value of large-scale endoscopic supervision and motion constraints for joint geometry estimation and tissue tracking.
tldr: SCOPE-4D is an endoscopic 4D geometry foundation model that jointly predicts camera parameters, dense geometry, and 3D tissue trajectories from monocular RGB video, trained on a new large-scale SCOPE-5K dataset with geometric supervision and a Common-Residual Motion constraint to improve camera/depth estimation and enable dense tissue tracking.
tldr_zh: SCOPE-4D是一种内窥镜4D几何基础模型，可从单目RGB视频中联合预测相机参数、稠密几何和3D组织轨迹，并利用新构建的SCOPE-5K数据集和Common-Residual Motion约束提升相机/深度估计，实现稠密组织跟踪。
summary_zh:
摘要：
几何理解支持内镜导航和机器人辅助，但学习可靠的内镜几何面临两大挑战：几何标注稀缺以及相机运动与组织形变之间的歧义。我们提出SCOPE-4D，一种内镜4D几何基础模型，可在单次前向传播中从单目RGB视频联合预测相机参数、稠密几何和3D组织轨迹。我们的整理与标注流程构建了SCOPE-5K数据集，包含约5000个片段，涵盖真实与合成的胃肠内镜和腹腔镜视频。该数据集提供丰富的几何监督，并包含新采集的体模和真实结肠镜评估集。基于SCOPE-5K的几何监督微调学习内镜先验，从而改进相机估计和深度估计。公共-残差运动（CRM）进一步约束相对于公共组织运动的局部形变。结合几何监督，CRM和轨迹监督在单独几何微调的基础上进一步改善了相机和深度估计，同时实现了稠密3D组织跟踪。在公共基准和新采集基准上的评估表明，该方法在域内和域外几何估计上均表现强劲，3D跟踪更优，长序列结肠重建更稳定。一项盲法用户研究进一步验证了真实临床视频上的感知重建质量。综上，这些结果证明了大规模内镜监督和运动约束对联合几何估计与组织跟踪的价值。

title: PsyEvo: A Personalized Counseling Agent That Self-Evolves at Test Time
summary: Mental health disorders affect a substantial proportion of the global population, yet a persistent shortage of trained practitioners leaves the majority without adequate care. Large language model (LLM)-based counselors present a promising direction for delivering scalable conversational psychological support. Offline model training alone leaves limited room to adapt to individual clients or to learn from ongoing therapeutic interaction at test time. We introduce PsyEvo, an LLM-based counseling framework that enables both client-specific personalization and response-policy improvement at test time through three components: Hierarchical Bayesian Skill Policy (HBSP) personalizes what intervention to apply by maintaining a per-client skill posterior updated from session feedback; Inter-session Listwise Preference Optimization (LiPO) improves how the selected skill is expressed by updating a shared response adapter from cross-client preference evidence; and State-conditioned Ordinal Credit Assignment (SOCA) supplies candidate preferences and trajectory credit to the two components through consistency-checked comparisons and ordinal projection. In simulated-client evaluation with shared online cohort adaptation, PsyEvo obtains 7.684 Overall on PsychEval and exceeds every component variant in each of three matched runs. Removing individual components lowers mean overall score by 0.138--0.171 under the shared configuration, supporting conditional contributions within the complete scaffold. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lingxi-mental-health/PsyEvo
tldr: PsyEvo is an LLM-based counseling framework that personalizes and improves at test time via hierarchical Bayesian skill policies, cross-client listwise preference optimization, and ordinal credit assignment; it outperforms component variants on PsychEval.
tldr_zh: PsyEvo 是一个基于大语言模型的咨询框架，通过在测试时进行个体化技能选择、跨客户端偏好优化与状态条件序数信用分配，在心理评估基准上优于各消融变体。
summary_zh: 心理健康障碍影响着全球相当比例的人口，然而训练有素的从业者长期短缺，导致大多数人无法获得充分的护理。基于大语言模型（LLM）的咨询系统为提供可扩展的对话式心理支持展现出了有前景的方向。仅靠离线模型训练在测试时难以适应个体来访者，也难以从持续的治疗互动中学习。我们提出了PsyEvo，一个基于LLM的咨询框架，通过三个组件实现在测试时的来访者个性化定制与响应策略改进：层次贝叶斯技能策略（HBSP）通过维护从会话反馈中更新的每位来访者技能后验分布，来个性化决定应用何种干预措施；会话间列表式偏好优化（LiPO）通过从跨来访者偏好证据中更新共享响应适配器，来改进所选技能的表达方式；状态条件序数信用分配（SOCA）通过一致性检验的比较和序数投影，为上述两个组件提供候选偏好与轨迹信用。在采用共享在线队列适应的模拟来访者评估中，PsyEvo在PsychEval上获得7.684的总分，并在三次匹配运行中均超过所有组件变体。在共享配置下，移除单个组件会使平均总分降低0.138–0.171，这支持了完整框架中各组件的条件性贡献。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Lingxi-mental-health/PsyEvo 获取。

title: EpiWorld: Grounding LLM Policy Agents in Epidemiological World Models
summary: Epidemic intervention policies are textual artefacts that human decision-makers interpret, justify, and revise through natural language, making large language models a natural candidate for epidemic policy reasoning. A naive LLM, however, lacks the epidemic dynamics needed to project intervention consequences, the quantitative surveillance signals required to assess severity, and the institutional constraints that define admissible actions. We present EpiWorld, a closed-loop framework that grounds an LLM policy actor in a learned action-conditioned epidemiological world model and a tiered skill library of public-health protocols, surveillance tools, and adaptive lessons accumulated through after-action analysis. Given a candidate intervention, the world model predicts regional epidemic evolution and enables fast counterfactual rollouts that provide feedback for policy selection and refinement. Outcomes of simulated futures are distilled into reusable lessons while protocol constraints remain fixed, allowing the decision process to improve without sacrificing interpretability or controllability. We evaluate both the world model and the end-to-end framework on retrospective COVID-19 and Influenza datasets: the world model achieves the best out-of-distribution Peak-MAE among all forecasting baselines, and the closed-loop framework reduces cumulative hospitalisation by up to 59% across datasets and by an average of ~16% across six LLM backbones, outperforming reinforcement-learning and optimal-control policy baselines.
tldr: EpiWorld grounds an LLM policy agent in a learned epidemiological world model and tiered skill library, enabling counterfactual policy evaluation and refinement for epidemic interventions. It improves forecasting accuracy and reduces cumulative hospitalizations on retrospective COVID-19 and Influenza benchmarks compared to RL and optimal-control baselines.
tldr_zh: EpiWorld 将 LLM 策略智能体与学习到的流行病学世界模型和分层技能库结合，支持反事实推演来评估和优化防疫干预政策。在 COVID-19 和流感回顾性数据上，其世界模型预测更准，闭环框架可将累计住院人数最多降低 59%，优于强化学习与最优控制基线。
summary_zh: 流行病干预政策是文本制品，人类决策者通过自然语言对其进行解读、论证和修订，这使得大语言模型成为流行病政策推理的天然候选者。然而，朴素的LLM缺乏预测干预后果所需的流行病动力学、评估严重程度所需的定量监测信号，以及界定可采取行动的体制约束。我们提出EpiWorld，一个闭环框架，将LLM政策行动者锚定在学习到的行动条件流行病世界模型和分层技能库中，该技能库包含公共卫生协议、监测工具以及通过事后分析积累的适应性经验。给定候选干预措施，世界模型预测区域流行病演变，并实现快速反事实推演，为政策选择和优化提供反馈。模拟未来结果被提炼为可复用经验，而协议约束保持固定，从而使决策过程能够在无损可解释性和可控性的情况下持续改进。我们在回顾性COVID-19和流感数据集上评估了世界模型和端到端框架：世界模型在分布外Peak-MAE指标上优于所有预测基线，闭环框架在数据集上将累计住院人数最多降低59%，在六个LLM主干上平均降低约16%，优于强化学习和最优控制策略基线。

title: RASPER: Reward-Aligned Summarization of Clinical Notes for EHR Outcome Prediction
summary: Unstructured discharge notes in Electronic Health Records (EHRs) often carry signal complementary to structured medical codes, holding patient-specific evidence that standardized cohort-level codes alone cannot capture. However, this evidence in notes is frequently buried in lengthy, noisy text that is not intentionally written with any specific clinical prediction in mind. Summarization is an obvious mitigation, but generic summaries, tuned for fluency rather than the outcome, routinely omit decisive evidence while retaining plausible but uninformative detail. To this end, we propose RASPER, a Reward-Aligned Summarizer for Prediction in EHR, that optimizes note summarization directly against the downstream clinical task. RASPER employs a tunable LLM-based summarizer to extract task-relevant evidence from discharge notes and trains it via reinforcement learning from prediction feedback, using a reward derived from the downstream predictor's loss. To ground the summarizer, a longitudinal encoder converts structured codes into soft prompts that incorporate each patient's clinical context into note summarization. By rewarding the quality of the resulting multimodal prediction, RASPER encourages the summarizer to retain patient-specific evidence that complements, rather than duplicates, information captured by structured codes. RASPER consistently outperforms strong baselines on both readmission prediction and medication recommendation across MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV.
tldr: RASPER trains an LLM-based summarizer via reinforcement learning using the downstream EHR predictor's loss as reward, with structured codes injected as soft prompts, so discharge-note summaries retain patient-specific evidence complementary to structured codes. It improves readmission prediction and medication recommendation on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV.
tldr_zh: RASPER 提出一种与下游临床预测任务对齐的出院小结摘要方法，利用强化学习根据预测损失优化 LLM 摘要器，并将结构化编码作为软提示以保留患者特定证据；在 MIMIC-III/IV 上优于基线。
summary_zh:
摘要：
电子健康档案（EHRs）中的非结构化出院记录通常携带与结构化医学编码互补的信号，包含标准化群体级编码无法捕捉的患者特异性证据。然而，这些记录中的证据往往深埋于冗长且嘈杂的文本中，而这些文本并非有意针对任何特定临床预测而撰写。摘要生成是一种明显的缓解手段，但通用型摘要为了流畅性而非结果进行调优，常常遗漏关键证据，同时保留看似合理却无信息量的细节。为此，我们提出RASPER——一种面向EHR预测的奖励对齐摘要器，它直接针对下游临床任务优化记录摘要生成。RASPER采用可调优的基于大语言模型的摘要器，从出院记录中提取任务相关证据，并通过基于预测反馈的强化学习进行训练，奖励信号来源于下游预测器的损失。为给摘要器提供基础，一个纵向编码器将结构化编码转换为软提示，将每位患者的临床背景融入记录摘要过程。通过奖励最终多模态预测的质量，RASPER促使摘要器保留与结构化编码互补而非重复的患者特异性证据。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上，RASPER在再入院预测和药物推荐任务中均持续优于强基线方法。
